name: Bobby
paragraphs: I'm a hardworking, honest person who enjoys helping others and spending time with friends. During my time at Hope House Guthrie, I also served as Senior House Leader.
I came to Hope House Guthrie to get off drugs, get my life together, and improve my health. Being there gave me structure that helped me stay away from drugs and alcohol.
I'm proud of how far I've come. I've improved my life and health, found a great job, and now have my own home and car.
I'm working toward six years clean while continuing to take care of my health.
quote: It has helped me get my life together and improve my health.
